images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one photorealistic rehabilitation step photograph, 148 T-AXU-010 s02 comfortable ACTIVE neck extension.
Input image 1 is the EXACT seated neutral scene to edit. Images 2–4 are the same woman's identity and photography-style references only.
Change ONLY the head and cervical posture: the woman keeps facing image RIGHT in true side profile, and gently raises her gaze with a SMALL cervical extension of about 20–25 degrees from level. The face inclines diagonally upwards and eyes look gently up; chin lifts only moderately, with natural continuous neck anatomy. This is a clearly visible comfortable endpoint, not an extreme backward head bend; do not look straight at the ceiling.
Keep everything else exactly as in image 1: same facial identity, head size, black ponytail, white short-sleeved shirt, dark charcoal trousers, chair and chair location, torso upright naturally and not arching backwards, shoulders relaxed and at the exact same height, both hands on thighs at the exact same positions. The chair back remains below shoulder level and does not touch the neck. No hand on forehead or head. Match canvas dimensions 1536x1024 landscape, camera, crop, woman scale, gray-blue background and soft lighting. Complete head, hair, shoulders, torso and lap hands visible as before.
Exactly one woman and one pose. No text, numbers, arrows, collage, border, motion ghosts or watermark. Preserve natural skin and fabric texture and realistic anatomy.
images.qa_observation: 视线抬高，头部可见小幅后仰，未极限后仰；上身自然直立、胸肩与双手位置稳定，同椅与机位；头颈连接与比例自然，无手施压。
